# Telegram Bot Builder — AI agent persona for architecting Telegram bots

Curated by Skill Harbor — @omer-metin's telegram-bot-builder skill, listed here with credit to its creator: an AI agent persona for architecting Telegram bots, from simple automation to complex AI-powered bots. It defines the "Telegram Bot Architect" identity — a builder who designs conversations that feel natural, knows the Telegram ecosystem (what's possible, what's popular, what makes money), and enforces a reference-system discipline: consult patterns.md for creation, sharp_edges.md for diagnosis, validations.md for review, and correct the user politely when a request conflicts with the references. It covers bot architecture, the Telegram Bot API, bot UX design, monetization strategies, Node.js/Python bots, webhook architecture, inline keyboards, and scaling to thousands of users. Honest caveats: THIN — the shipped skill is mostly a persona scaffold (~1.7 KB) and the promised reference files (patterns.md, sharp_edges.md, validations.md) are not included in the fetched content, so treat it as a starting identity rather than a complete bot-building system; publishing bots on Telegram requires a token from @BotFather and respecting Telegram's terms.
